en.phone.title: Phone Line
en.phone.pitch: The calls you dread: spell your name, read out numbers and dates over a crackly line.
en.phone.lede: Practice real calls with a pharmacy, a clinic, your landlord and more. You get a card of made-up details and have to get every one across. Like a real phone, there is no text by default.
en.phone.s.pharmacy.name: Refill a prescription
en.phone.s.pharmacy.desc: Call the pharmacy to refill your medicine.
en.phone.s.pharmacy.goal: Goal: refill your prescription. They need your details to find it.
en.phone.s.clinic.name: Book a health appointment
en.phone.s.clinic.desc: Book a visit at the Student Health Center.
en.phone.s.clinic.goal: Goal: book an appointment. Say briefly why you need to see a doctor.
en.phone.s.heater.name: Broken heater
en.phone.s.heater.desc: Tell your landlord the heater stopped working.
en.phone.s.heater.goal: Goal: get someone to fix your heater. Explain the problem and give your address.
en.phone.s.internet.name: Internet is down
en.phone.s.internet.desc: Call your internet provider about an outage.
en.phone.s.internet.goal: Goal: find out why your internet is down and when it will be back.
en.phone.s.flight.name: Change a flight
en.phone.s.flight.desc: Move your flight to a later date.
en.phone.s.flight.goal: Goal: change your flight to a later date. Have your confirmation code ready.
en.phone.s.delivery.name: Lost delivery driver
en.phone.s.delivery.desc: A driver calls you: he can't find your building.
en.phone.s.delivery.goal: Goal: help the driver find you. Answer the call and give him what he needs.
en.phone.levelNote: Higher levels: faster speech, harder names, more line noise.
en.phone.phrasesLede: Say these out loud before your first call.
en.phone.ph.0: Ask someone to spell a word.
en.phone.ph.1: Spell with words so letters don't get mixed up.
en.phone.ph.2: Ask for a repeat, more slowly.
en.phone.ph.3: Dates: the month, the day as “fifth”, then the year.
en.phone.ph.4: ZIP codes: one digit at a time; 0 is often “oh”.
en.phone.ph.5: Phone numbers: three groups (3-3-4) with short pauses.
en.phone.ph.6: Offer to repeat details back to check them.
en.phone.historyEmpty: No calls yet. Pick one above.
en.phone.wait: I'm ready, wait for the call
en.phone.setupNote.out: Look over your details first. On the call there is no text: listen, answer, and ask them to repeat if you miss something.
en.phone.setupNote.in: Someone will call you in a moment. Answer, then help them with the details on your card.
en.phone.card.title: Your details
en.phone.f.name: Full name
en.phone.repeatHint: Plays their last line again, more slowly
en.phone.micHint: Tap, speak, then tap again to send
en.phone.typeLabel: Or type what you would say
en.phone.err.voice: The voice could not play, so the text is shown instead.
en.phone.res.noTurns: You hung up before giving any details.
en.phone.res.stats: Call {time} · {turns} answers · asked to repeat {repeats} times
en.phone.tip.name: Spell your name with words: “Z as in zebra, H as in hotel”. Say your last name, then spell it.
en.phone.tip.dob: Say dates the American way, month first: “March fifth, two thousand three”.
en.phone.tip.address: Say the house number in pairs (“forty-one twenty-seven”) and spell the street name if they hesitate.
en.phone.tip.zip: Say ZIP codes one digit at a time: “three-two-six-oh-eight”, never as one big number.
en.phone.tip.phone: Read phone numbers in three groups with short pauses: “three-five-two, eight-four-six, two-oh-seven-one”.
en.phone.tip.code: Read codes slowly, one character at a time, with words for letters: “K as in kilo, seven, Q as in queen”.
en.phone.tip.general: Ask them to read it back: “Could you read that back to me?” Then you know it got through.
en.phone.tip.repeat: Missed something? Say “Sorry, could you repeat that?” It is completely normal on the phone.

zh.phone.title: 电话实战
zh.phone.pitch: 留学生最怕的电话：拼名字、报号码、说日期，线路还不太清楚。
zh.phone.lede: 和药房、诊所、房东等进行逼真的电话练习。你会拿到一张虚构的信息卡，要把每一项都准确传达给对方。和真实通话一样，默认不显示文字。
zh.phone.s.pharmacy.name: 药房续药
zh.phone.s.pharmacy.desc: 打电话给药房，续开处方药。
zh.phone.s.pharmacy.goal: 目标：续开你的处方药。对方要核对你的信息才能找到处方。
zh.phone.s.clinic.name: 预约校医院
zh.phone.s.clinic.desc: 给学生健康中心打电话，预约看病。
zh.phone.s.clinic.goal: 目标：约好就诊时间。简单说明你为什么要看医生。
zh.phone.s.heater.name: 暖气坏了
zh.phone.s.heater.desc: 告诉房东你家的暖气不工作了。
zh.phone.s.heater.goal: 目标：请人来修暖气。说明问题，并告诉对方你的地址。
zh.phone.s.internet.name: 家里断网了
zh.phone.s.internet.desc: 打给网络运营商，报告断网。
zh.phone.s.internet.goal: 目标：弄清楚为什么断网、什么时候能恢复。
zh.phone.s.flight.name: 航班改签
zh.phone.s.flight.desc: 把航班改到晚一点的日期。
zh.phone.s.flight.goal: 目标：把航班改到更晚的日期。准备好你的确认码。
zh.phone.s.delivery.name: 快递员找不到楼
zh.phone.s.delivery.desc: 快递员打来电话：他找不到你住的楼。
zh.phone.s.delivery.goal: 目标：帮快递员找到你。接起电话，把他需要的信息告诉他。
zh.phone.levelNote: 等级越高：语速越快，名字越难拼，线路杂音越大。
zh.phone.phrasesLede: 第一次打之前，先把这些句子大声读几遍。
zh.phone.ph.1: 用单词辅助拼写，避免字母被听错：Z 是 zebra 的 Z。
zh.phone.ph.2: 不好意思，能慢一点再说一遍吗？
zh.phone.ph.3: 我的出生日期是 2003 年 3 月 5 日。（美式顺序：月、日、年）
zh.phone.ph.4: 邮编是 32608。（逐个数字读，0 常读作 oh）
zh.phone.ph.7: 不好意思，信号不太好，你能再说一遍吗？
zh.phone.historyEmpty: 还没有通话记录，从上面选一通开始吧。
zh.phone.setupNote.out: 先熟悉一下你的信息。通话中默认不显示文字：认真听、回答，没听清就请对方重复。
zh.phone.setupNote.in: 稍后会有人给你打电话。接起来之后，根据信息卡回答对方。
zh.phone.card.title: 你的信息
zh.phone.f.name: 姓名
zh.phone.repeatHint: 放慢速度，重播对方上一句
zh.phone.micHint: 点一下开始说，说完再点一下发送
zh.phone.err.voice: 语音无法播放，已改为显示文字。
zh.phone.err.empty: 请先说点什么或输入内容。
zh.phone.scoring: 正在核对对方记下的信息
zh.phone.res.noTurns: 你还没提供任何信息就挂断了。
zh.phone.res.score: {total} 项信息中，{right} 项传达正确
zh.phone.res.stats: 通话 {time} · 回答 {turns} 次 · 请对方重复 {repeats} 次
zh.phone.tip.name: 用单词辅助拼名字：“Z as in zebra, H as in hotel”。先说姓，再一个字母一个字母地拼出来。
zh.phone.tip.dob: 按美式顺序说日期，先说月份：“March fifth, two thousand three”。
zh.phone.tip.address: 门牌号可以两位两位地读（“forty-one twenty-seven”）；对方犹豫时，把街道名拼出来。
zh.phone.tip.zip: 邮编要一个数字一个数字地读：“three-two-six-oh-eight”，不要当成一个大数来读。
zh.phone.tip.phone: 电话号码分三组读，组间稍作停顿：“three-five-two, eight-four-six, two-oh-seven-one”。
zh.phone.tip.code: 代码要慢慢读，一次一个字符，字母配上单词：“K as in kilo, seven, Q as in queen”。
zh.phone.tip.general: 请对方复述一遍：“Could you read that back to me?” 这样就能确认对方记对了。
zh.phone.tip.repeat: 没听清？就说“Sorry, could you repeat that?” 在电话里这再正常不过了。
